# Results (generated by `python -m freight.run`)

Simulated data, seed 7: 7,398 delivered shipments, 52,046 tonnes.

* On-time rate 75.3%; freight cost EUR 0.131 per kg; margin after landed cost 17.8%.
* Customs-hold months (Dec, Jan, Jul): 28.2% of shipments late versus 23.8% in other months (z = 3.65, p = 0.0003).
* Cheapest carrier by freight price differs from the cheapest in total on 6 of 6 lanes.
* Optimised carrier mix: expected cost 0.1436 to 0.1404 EUR per kg (2.3%, about EUR 169,652 over the period) while on-time delivery goes from 75.1% to 86.7%.
